ruling.recommended_action: Close the dispute: the $6.61 no-show cancellation fee stands and the driver's $4.50 share is released; no account action on either party.

rejected_claims.reason: The rider argues NS-1(i)-(iii) are not met, but the trace and records show the tap at 18:22:50, 41 m from the pickup [F6][F1], and 230 s of continuous in-range waiting after the tap before the 18:26:40 cancellation [F6][F4] — all three conditions are satisfied [NS-1].
Correct that the clock runs from the tap, but that arithmetic (3 min 50 s) still exceeds the >3-minute threshold, so it supports the fee rather than defeating it [F6][F4][NS-1].
Profile facts F17/F18 cannot decide the case; the driver's single upheld no-show dispute is not 'repeated' conduct and no NS clause converts it into a refund or account action [F17][F18][NS-1][NS-2].
NS-2's refund route opens only when NS-1 fails; here all three NS-1 limbs are met, so the $6.61 on record is correctly retained [F6][F2][F8][NS-1][NS-2].
Accepted only in part: rain does not waive the fee [F16], but NS-7 discretion is not invoked because no NS-1 condition failed [F16][NS-1][NS-7].
